bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; extending availability for relocation grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. RELOCATION GRANTS.

The commissioner of employment and economic development must reissue a request for proposal for relocation grants under Laws 2024, chapter 120, article 1, section 2, paragraph (i). The commissioner must make best efforts to conduct outreach and provide technical assistance to businesses eligible for the grants. The appropriation under Laws 2024, chapter 120, article 1, section 2, paragraph (i), is available until June 30, 2026.
additions: The commissioner of employment and economic development must reissue a request for proposal for relocation grants under Laws 2024, chapter 120, article 1, section 2, paragraph (i). The commissioner must make best efforts to conduct outreach and provide technical assistance to businesses eligible for the grants. The appropriation under Laws 2024, chapter 120, article 1, section 2, paragraph (i), is available until June 30, 2026.
